privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy describes how VoyageRespond ("we", "us", or "our") collects, uses, and shares your personal information when you use our service.

collection.title: Information We Collect
collection.content: We collect information you provide directly to us, including your name, email address, business information, and Google Business Profile data when you connect your account.

usage.title: How We Use Your Information
usage.content: We use the information we collect to provide, maintain, and improve our services, to process your requests, and to communicate with you about your account and our services.

sharing.title: Information Sharing
sharing.content: We do not sell your personal information. We may share your information with service providers who assist us in operating our platform, and as required by law.

security.title: Data Security
security.content: We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your personal information against unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction.

rights.title: Your Rights
rights.content: You have the right to access, correct, or delete your personal information. You may also object to or restrict certain processing of your data.

contact.title: Contact Us
contact.content: If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us at privacy@voyagerespond.com

terms.intro: By accessing or using VoyageRespond, you agree to be bound by these Terms of Service.

acceptance.title: Acceptance of Terms
acceptance.content: By using our service, you agree to these terms. If you do not agree, please do not use our service.

account.title: Account Registration
account.content: You must provide accurate and complete information when creating an account. You are responsible for maintaining the security of your account credentials.

usage.title: Acceptable Use
usage.content: You agree to use our service only for lawful purposes and in accordance with these Terms. You may not use our service in any way that could damage or impair our platform.

subscription.title: Subscription and Payment
subscription.content: Paid subscriptions are billed in advance on a monthly or yearly basis. You may cancel your subscription at any time, and cancellation will take effect at the end of the current billing period.

termination.title: Termination
termination.content: We may terminate or suspend your account immediately, without prior notice, for any breach of these Terms.

liability.title: Limitation of Liability

contact.content: If you have any questions about these Terms, please contact us at support@voyagerespond.com
